sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Gladiator Life - Part 9 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov Arena.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "I'm easing you higher and higher, step by step. You better appreciate it, fighter! I pulled some strings with a few people, they're ready to take a look at you. Don't screw this up! All you have to do is stay alive in the fight as long as you can."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Claim at least 5th place in Last Hero mode

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +4,000 EXP
- 55,000 Roubles
- 10 GP coins
- Unlocks Beret (Olive Drab) in the Armory
- Unlocks German Flecktarn weapon camouflage
